schema: FloraGPA native Windows sustained workflow acceptance 1

inherited_compatibility_baseline.scope: Unchanged 44-file package; no new full matrix or original-player comparison

source_hash_policy: Bytes with CRLF normalized to LF

native_soak.phase_timing_scope: End-to-end test phases including waits, instrumentation and exports; not UI event-loop latency or isolated performance benchmarks

process_memory.scope: Sequential metadata from one instrumented test process. Address reuse and copy-on-write are not resolved. Serialization affects subsequent samples. Heap-associated commit is not live-object size. This is not leak-free certification.

deployment_availability.scope: Read-only local availability check; no virtualization or operating system features changed. This host check is not clean-host acceptance.

limits: Native Windows MainWindow test on this host and driver; not an independent clean Windows deployment
Sustained workload is GF2/BF1 with the recorded recovery, Query, API and structure workflows, not every analyzer or capture
Package and incremental test use unchanged production sources; this batch does not repeat the prior archived-source build
Process-wide memory includes test history, logs, Qt caches and allocator effects; clearing is diagnostic only
Read-only source inspection and a brief metadata survey overlap the run; timings are not isolated benchmarks
M3/M4/M5 and module ledger remain incomplete
